name: The AMB Evening Edit
subject: One piece. Three plans. That is the point.
preheader: The AMB pieces designed to work harder in your wardrobe — from daytime plans to dinner.
headline: The best piece in your wardrobe is the one you keep finding reasons to wear.
intro: A polished wardrobe does not need more noise. It needs pieces that can shift with you — coffee to dinner, weekday to weekend, understated to dressed-up with just a change of accessories. Tonight, we are editing for versatility.
heroAlt: The AMB BOUTIQUE evening editorial edit
productSectionTitle: Six pieces with more than one plan.
closingTitle: If you can already picture three ways to wear it, it belongs in the edit.
closingBody: Start with the silhouette that feels most like you. Add the shoe, bag or layer that changes the mood. The goal is not to own more — it is to have more ways to wear what you choose.
